THEMA · universe L · thema_L_x2

8,740 themes over the 5,539 atomic pathways. Click any theme to open it.

Read these before the numbers.

The universe is not the 10,770. It is the 5,539 atomic pathways — every curated summary (a pathway with at least one descendant in the universe) was removed before building. Recall figures here are not comparable with any 10,770 number.

Themes are unnamed. The namer has never been run on a universe-L build, so each theme is shown by the member names nearest its centroid. Those are members, not a label.

support is the share of 200 resampled runs holding a matching theme at Jaccard 0.70, the build's own threshold. s@0.5 is the same at Jaccard 0.50. A large gap means the theme recurs in a slightly different form each run rather than being absent.

coh is mean pairwise gene overlap against a size-matched random set. Below 3× a theme is not distinguishable from a random set of its size; those are flagged.

The 10 roots of 1,000+ members are flagged. They are gene-incoherent (0.7×–3.9×) while their children are not (median 24×), and they share most of their children with each other, so they read better as overlapping bags than as areas.
